name: hcportal_addEditNewsflash
description: Creates or updates a portal newsflash. When @newsflashId is NULL a new row is inserted with the calling admin's hasherId recorded as CreatedByHasherId. When @newsflashId is provided the existing active (IsDeleted=0) newsflash is updated. Image upload to Azure Blob Storage is handled by the Flutter portal before calling this SP — @imageUrl receives the resulting blob URL. An empty or whitespace-only @imageUrl is treated as NULL (no image / clear existing image). Validation is fast-failed before the auth round-trip. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth with NULL callerParamString. There is no permission gate beyond a valid portal token (see codeSmells). HC.PortalNewsflash is defined in db/hc6/portal/archive/create_portal_newsflash_tables.sql (not in db/schema/tables).

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Auth: device ID. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth: short-lived cryptographic token. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth with NULL callerParamString.

parameters.name: newsflashId
parameters.description: NULL to add a new newsflash; provide an existing GUID to edit. On edit, the newsflash must exist and not be soft-deleted.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Required. Trimmed before storage. Validated for NULL/empty before auth.

parameters.name: bodyText
parameters.description: Required. Trimmed before storage. Validated for NULL/empty before auth.

parameters.name: imageUrl
parameters.description: Optional Azure Blob URL. NULL or empty string sets ImageUrl to NULL (no image / clears existing image).

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Required. The date from which the newsflash becomes active. Validated for NULL before auth.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Optional. If provided must be >= @startDate. NULL = no expiry.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Optional. NULL = platform-wide newsflash shown to all users. When provided, the kennel must exist in HC.Kennel.

rowsets.name: SuccessEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned on every outcome — success, validation failure ('Title is required', 'Body text is required', 'Start date is required', 'End date must be on or after start date'), auth failure, 'Kennel not found', 'Newsflash not found', or runtime error (ERROR_MESSAGE()).

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: NULL on success, error message on failure

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.PortalNewsflash SET Title, BodyText, ImageUrl, StartDate, EndDate, KennelId, UpdatedAt — when @newsflashId is provided

codeSmells.detail: After HC6.ValidatePortalAuth (lines 72-80) any authenticated portal user may create or overwrite a newsflash, including a platform-wide one (@kennelId NULL) and one targeted at any kennel. There is no HC.PlatformAdmin or kennel-role check, and no ownership check on edit (CreatedByHasherId is not compared).

codeSmells.issue: CATCH does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: Lines 134-137 roll back and return the envelope without writing HC.ErrorLog.
@title NVARCHAR(250) (line 6) silently truncates a longer title instead of returning an error; the column is also 250, so declare NVARCHAR(MAX) and check LEN().

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change the empty-string-to-NULL normalisation for @imageUrl without coordinating with the portal client
